"""监管树崩溃自动恢复测试。"""
import sys, os, time, threading, logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.WARNING)
os.chdir(r"D:\LAAP")
sys.path.insert(0, r"D:\LAAP")
from laap.daemon import Supervisor

sv = Supervisor()

# 注册一个会很快崩溃的进程（模拟崩溃）
proc = sv.register_custom(
    "crashy",
    [sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(0.5)"],  # 0.5 秒后退出
    max_retries=2,
)
sv.start_all()
print("Started crashy, PID:", proc.pid)

# 等它崩溃并自动重启
time.sleep(3)
s = proc.get_status()
print("After crash attempt:", s["state"], "retry:", s["retry_count"])
assert s["state"] in ("running", "recovering", "crashed"), f"Unexpected state: {s['state']}"

# 观察自动恢复
time.sleep(4)
s = proc.get_status()
print("After recovery:", s["state"], "retry:", s["retry_count"])
print("restart attempts:", s["retry_count"])

sv.stop_all(timeout=3)
print("崩溃自动恢复测试完成")
print(f"Escalation count: {sv._escalation_count}")
